description.value: Black Bear Resort is a cedar-clad hotel and cabin resort on the northern tip of Vancouver Island, offering 40 ocean-view guest rooms and 11 cabins overlooking Port McNeill harbour, Malcolm Island, and the BC coastal mountains. The property sits on the fringe of a natural rainforest and is within easy reach of the town centre, BC Ferries connections to Alert Bay and Sointula, and access to the Broughton Archipelago. It is well positioned as a base for cyclists exploring northern Vancouver Island's coastal communities.

address.value: 1812 Campbell Way, Port McNeill, BC V0N 2R0

The policies page confirms a complimentary continental breakfast is included, and the front page notes proximity to 'various restaurants.' Phone and address on the website match OSM exactly.
